title: Recurrence for average query cost
statement: For every natural number $n$ and real number $p$, the average query cost at $n+1$ satisfies $C_{n+1}(p)=1+(1-p)C_n(p)$, where $C_n(p)=\\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(1-p)^k$.
